ActorTalk: Ugh, my graduation thesis got rejected again... Prof said researching a transportation system that runs directly from the classroom to the dorm entrance has "no practical value."
Walking distance from classroom to dormitory: 327m. Time: 4min 17sec.
I know it's not that far! But I'm just wiped after class. I really don't feel like dragging myself all the way back... If only there was some kind of cart to drop me right at my door...
Wait... is the Fog incident's data live now?
Affirmative. "Fog Incident" space-time data has been uploaded to the college database. Access restriction: Partial content visible to all faculty and student credentials.

I remember! When we passed through the Fog, the navigation showed we'd traveled over a hundred thousand kilometers, but only a few minutes actually passed... Space was compressed! If I can use this data, I won't just be researching some vehicle anymore. I'll be researching... a wormhole portal!
Try to understand the assignment. No vehicles required for moving from Point A to Point B.
Yes! Now THIS is real valuable research! I'm downloading that data right now!
